name: Form Process Quality Control
implementation_notes: Process Quality Control Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from processQualityControlRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Clarification Detail (screen-079's mobile precedent)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormClarificationView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 dari 14 kolom bacaan/keterangan terisi) validated at FE + repo level (processQualityControlRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws ProcessQualityControlDetailRequiredError) -- Shift and QC Inspector ID are identifying/context columns excluded from the 'filled' check, mirroring ProcessWaterRecordService's shift/inspector_id exclusion

16 non-time_slot columns per row (the MOST of any station in the project): 12 numeric readings across Fruit Press/Purifier & Clarification Balance/Vacuum Drying Station/Decanter-Centrifuge/Final Storage are plain type=number FormFields; Shift/QC Inspector ID/QC Engineering Corrective Actions/Findings are plain text FormFields -- NO enum/status dropdowns anywhere on this screen
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Boiler Room: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. fruit-press-oil-loss-in-sludge-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- same defensive pattern as FormClarificationView.vue

Field order in the grid & template mirrors the migration column order exactly: Shift -> Fruit Press Oil Loss in Sludge -> Fruit Press Oil Loss in Fibre -> Purifier & Clarification Balance Inlet Temp -> Purifier & Clarification Balance Backpressure -> Vacuum Drying Station Drier Temp -> Vacuum Drying Station Vacuum Pressure -> Decanter/Centrifuge Feed Rate -> Decanter/Centrifuge Oil Loss in Cake -> Final Storage FFA -> Final Storage Moisture Content -> Final Storage Impurities/Dirt -> Final Storage DOBI Index -> QC Inspector ID -> QC Engineering Corrective Actions -> Findings = 16 total

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (FormProcessQualityControlView.spec.ts, 20 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full Simpan/Pause/Clear/Back flow in a live dev server.
